Good afternoon.

I am awaiting resolution of multiple situations.

Regards, João Matos

Excellent quality doghouse, I've had mine for a few months now, it's been through days of heavy rain and no water has gotten inside. I highly recommend it. I had a small delay and a missing part, but it was resolved.
Terrible service, I don't recommend it.

I purchased a doghouse on August 30, 2025, which was paid for in full, and I was told it would be delivered within 15 business days.

15 working days have passed and I have not received any information about the delivery of the doghouse. I called to ask about its status, and was told it would be delivered the following week. Since then, it has been the same thing. I called again on 10/11/2025 and was told it would be delivered on 10/15/2025. The 15th arrived and nothing was delivered, and as always, they provide no information. I called today, 10/16/2025, and to my surprise, the doghouse is still not ready for delivery. I said they would have to deliver the doghouse by Saturday, otherwise I would demand my money back. They told me that the owner of Casotas e Companhia would contact me by 8:00 PM today to resolve the problem, but I was not contacted.

They are playing games with the customer, they don't give any information, weeks of silence from the company.

Huge communication failure. I was waiting for a quote and they stopped responding.
My partner had also tried to request service and also received no response.
This is very unpleasant.
Thank you very much for your feedback, it is extremely important to us.

Excellent work, serious people dedicated to what they do!
I recommend them 100%!

I can't help but share my delight with the kennel they made for my lucky cat. Besides the excellent work, we were received with open arms. I couldn't be happier.
I recommend them 100%! It couldn't be better! Thank you so much, Casotas&Companhia! 😁

Super happy with the service and the doghouses
Thank you 😃☺️😃😃😃😃 …

Thank you very much for your feedback. We are happy that it met your expectations.

Best regards, Casotas&Companhia
Spectacular playhouse! Super sturdy. My daughter loved it, and I wish I were her age so I could play there too!

I highly recommend Casotas & Companhia! The dog houses are beautiful, well-built, and made with great attention to detail. You can see the care and love for animals in each piece. Mine arrived quickly and is exactly as I imagined—my furry friend loved it and adapted right away! Thank you for the excellent service. 🐾❤️ …
Super attentive, quality materials. My Sharpei loved her personalized pink house! I highly recommend them. Thank you!

Update – June 2025
I want to update my previous comment, following a phone call made by the manager of Casotas & Companhia himself, in which he demonstrated professionalism, a sense of responsibility, and openness to clarifying what went wrong in this process.

The truth is that, despite all the communication failures I reported, the product was delivered with the quality that the brand has accustomed us to and within the deadline that I myself stipulated. I must acknowledge that, regarding the commitment to delivery, the company fulfilled its promise.

The call I received demonstrated a genuine concern for the service provided and for customer opinion – something increasingly rare. It was possible to maintain an assertive, serious, and respectful conversation, allowing us to understand both perspectives. This attitude, coming from a Portuguese company, is commendable and should serve as an example for many others.

Although I maintain my criticism of how the process was managed from a certain point onwards, I also want to positively acknowledge the renewed contact, and I sincerely hope that the company continues to evolve in order to provide service that matches the quality of its products.

May 2025
In 2019 or 2020 I bought my dog's kennel from Casotas & Companhia and I was extremely satisfied with the service and the quality of the product – so much so that I trusted them again this year to buy a new bed.

Unfortunately, the experience this time was anything but positive. The order was placed on April 3, 2025, and although the product finally arrived (with good quality, as usual), the journey to get here was frankly disappointing.

I had to deal with weeks of silence after payment, contradictory information, lack of response to several emails (including one where I set a final delivery deadline), and a total absence of reaction to public comments made on the brand's social media.

The product arrived on the last day of the deadline I stipulated before taking further action – but I deeply regret that it had to come to this point to obtain what was due to me.

The product quality deserves praise.

Customer service, after-sales support, and communication fell far short of acceptable standards.

I sincerely hope that Casotas & Companhia recovers the good service it demonstrated in the past, because its products deserve to be accompanied by an equally positive shopping experience.

Not recommended, incorrect information. After some online research, I discovered that two companies are listed on the website. The woman on the phone claimed that they work together. FALSE!!!! Casotas & Companhia has nothing to do with Casotas Balgavas!!!! The woman needs better training and should be taught that the internet reveals a lot. Anyone who values ​​quality should order elsewhere. I certainly won't be buying anything here.
